schedule_detail_records.DOAH-M1: 3,730 CFM supply at 1.9 in. w.g. with one 7.5 HP supply fan; 3,400 CFM exhaust at 1.1 in. w.g. with one 3 HP exhaust fan. Cooling: 216.2 MBH total, 106.7 MBH sensible, 45/55 F water, 43.2 GPM. Heating: 112.8 MBH, 130/110 F water, 11.3 GPM. The second schedule part prints energy-wheel summer/winter conditions, 460/60/3, 17.11/19.86 electrical values, a 30 A value, and Division 23 VFD provision. This is one two-part schedule identity, not two units.
